newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil closes up on supportive export data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil closes up on supportive export data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices surged in active trade on brisk afternoon buying on higher Dec 1-15 export data despite neutral official PORLA November crop data. Technical buying also emerged when February futures broke the 1,215 ringgit. The next resistance will be 1,235 ringgit.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed the futures trend and interest was confined to nearby crude palm oil and selected products.
Cargo surveyor, Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for December 1-15 at 406,924 tonnes compared with 298,862 tonnes for November 1-15.

The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing and Authority (PORLA), which announced the data after the closure of the morning market, said palm oil stocks at the end of November were 955,965 tonnes, compared with trade expectations of around 965,000 tonnes. Private crop forecaster Ivan Wong on Friday estimated end-November stocks at 960,000 tonnes.
PORLA put crude palm oil production in November at 762,540 tonnes and palm oil exports at 632,441 tonnes.
